purpose: Smallest isolated hardware probe that reads the BCM2069 radio revision / PLL selector for this exact BCM4352 board and stops. DESIGN + STATIC + SIGNED; NOT executed.
hardware_test_go: YES (isolated radio_id_probe_only candidate only; owner approval required; the global D4 HARDWARE TEST GO remains NO)

earliest_safe_probe_point.vendor_evidence: wlc_phy_attach (radio reg 0/1 read) is called ONLY from wlc_bmac_attach @0x6a138, after wlc_bmac_corereset @0x69b1c and BEFORE si_clkctl_init @0x6aa20, ucode upload, common initvals, dma_attach and every later stage
earliest_safe_probe_point.prefix: bcma_host_pci_up + bcma_core_enable(D11) + bcma_core_set_clockmode(FAST) + D11 MAC-PHY clock (SICF_MPCLKE, BCMA_IOCTL bit 4)
earliest_safe_probe_point.prefix_rationale: D11-side register window bring-up, already hardware-proven (M2.5/D3A0). wlc_bmac_core_phypll_ctl is a proven NO-OP for rev42 (early return at phyrev>0x27 == 42).

prerequisites.name: PCI/BCMA host up
prerequisites.evidence: radio window is a D11 register access

prerequisites.name: HT/FAST clock
prerequisites.evidence: vendor sets FAST before the read; M2.5 proven

prerequisites.name: D11 PHY clock (SICF_MPCLKE)
prerequisites.evidence: vendor corereset sets D11 core cflags on the AC branch before the read; hardware-proven in D3A0/D3A1

prerequisites.name: D3A1 vendor tail
prerequisites.evidence: vendor read precedes the post-common tail

prerequisites.name: PHY attach software object (pi)
prerequisites.evidence: the window is raw D11; the probe does not build pi

prerequisites.name: radio-window selector write
prerequisites.evidence: data port is only meaningful for the latched register

prerequisites.name: MAC suspend state
prerequisites.evidence: not referenced by the read path

prerequisites.name: wlc_bmac_phy_reset (PMU/PHY PLL programming)
prerequisites.evidence: vendor runs it before the read; the read may not need it. The probe omits all PHY/PLL writes by design and validates the window via the radio-id check; a failed validation is a bounded, non-crashing result that proves the dependency without any PHY/PLL write.

probe_class_detail.reason: the 0x3d8 address latch is written before each 0x3da data read; it selects a read window and does not change RF/PLL/radio config
probe_class_detail.selector_write_is_safe: exact vendor read_radio_reg / wlc_phy_attach primitive; no RF state change

registers.ordering_barrier: none required by the vendor primitive; the probe does a single write+read pair per register
registers.reg1_justification: radio-id identity validation for BCM2069 (accepted {0x2069,0x030B}); material for correct-window detection

extraction.branch: class 1 -> A; class 2 -> B; 2069 other class -> SKIP; radio_id != 0x2069 -> UNKNOWN

dev_lost_safety.pre_access_guard: ob_d11_read32_trusted(MACCONTROL 0x0120); all-ones latches dev_lost and stops before any write
dev_lost_safety.after_latch: zero hardware writes, zero reset/quiesce MMIO, resources retained, module pinned, reboot required

rejects: malformed log (no BEGIN / no PASS / no STOPPED line)
impossible extraction (declared decode disagrees with reg0/reg1)

failure_matrix.case: prerequisite unavailable (host up / core enable fails)
radio selector access fails (latch flips before a write)

failure_matrix.detail: no PHY/PLL write issued; bounded failure
hardware left as-is (D11 core enabled + macphyclk), same as the ucode/initvals isolated modes

failure_matrix.rc_note: probe success kept to retain state
failure_matrix.detail: module pinned; no MMIO; only reboot clears
